title: Giving Way
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Ask for one specific episode in detail rather than a general account.
Ask what they were doing: turning, stepping down, running in a straight line, or standing still.
Ask which way the knee went, accepting that many patients cannot say and that a guess is worse than an admission.
Ask whether they fell, whether the knee swelled afterwards, and how long it took to settle.
Ask whether they expected it, because a knee that gives way without warning is a different problem from one that fails during a movement the patient knew was risky.
Ask what they no longer do.
Ask whether the episode resembles the original symptom: a return suggests graft failure.
